classification.difficultyReason: Distinguish the fixed fee from the hourly charge, build the table including zero hours, then express and evaluate the same relationship algebraically.

inlines.text: A plumber charges a $50 call-out fee and $100 per hour.
: the call-out fee applies even at zero hours.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the total cost, in dollars, if the plumber works for $t$ hours. Give an expression.

inlines.text: dollars. Adding the $50 call-out fee gives

children.label: c
children.prompt: Substitute $t=30$ into your expression to find how much it will cost for 30 hours of work.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Total cost}&=50+100(30)\\\text{Total cost}&=50+3000\\\text{Total cost}&=3050\end{align*}$$
The cost is $\$3050$.
